_comment: Hand-maintained overrides for event-to-place venue matching (tier 1 of the matcher in app.js linkEventsToPlaces). Keys are NORMALIZED event location strings: lowercase, punctuation stripped, single spaces, leading 'the' dropped. Values are directory place slugs (see slugify in scripts/sync-directory.js). The browser console logs 'venue-match: unmatched locations' as alias candidates. Edit directly.
